title: Register the 21 observed fallback paths; remove the spurious solve rewind
this_is_the_behaviour_change: S1-A/S1-C-prep/S1-D were all no-ops by construction. S1-B-activate is the single step that changes what a change to a registered path means.

registration.why_no_delivery_flag_flips: Promoting any of these into the final-input or submission closure would change what the audit consumes or what ships. That is a separate, explicitly reviewed decision, not a side effect of removing a misclassification (Q2: default submission_member=False).

producer_consumer_reading.requirement: Q2 forbids guessing the delivery flags; each path was read
producer_consumer_reading.no_python_producer: none of the 21 basenames appears anywhere in factory_core/apps/scripts/web, so they are agent-authored artifacts
producer_consumer_reading.canonical_results_evidence_closure: results/canonical_results.json lists m1_solver_evidence.json and m4_solver_evidence.json among its evidence files -> those two keep the result rewind (RESULT@4). Dropping it would let a genuine result-evidence change pass unnoticed.
producer_consumer_reading.model_source_map: referenced by model.md and step4_reuse_gap_record.md; structurally an index (schema/scope/primary/auxiliary/files/implementation_locators/canonical_plan/derived_plan) -> EVIDENCE_INDEX, routed RESULT@4
producer_consumer_reading.derived_verification_chain: derived_artifacts_verification.latest.json binds results_values.tex by byte comparison with 'matches_regenerated': true -> the two .tex artifacts and the appendix generator are PRESENTATION_ONLY (FORMAT@9) and rely on that chain instead of a rewind
producer_consumer_reading.exploratory: pro01/** including input_arrays.npz is EXPLORATORY + EXPLICIT_ONLY with both delivery flags false, so NON_BLOCKING_BY_POLICY applies (Q3)

measured_effect_on_real_history.note: an unknown path still yields the pair, so the fail-closed default is intact

identity_changes.why_the_classifier_identity_moves: NATIVE_POLICY decides which DirtyChange a path produces, so the registry holding it joined classifier_contract_sha256() - this is exactly Q14's rule: what a change PRODUCES belongs to the classifier identity; WHY it was attributed belongs to the provenance identity.
identity_changes.consequence: existing obligations keep their recorded identity until an explicit `factory rebase-classifier` runs - 0.7.1 removed the automatic read-triggered rebase, so no project is mutated merely by being opened

history_integrity.verified_on_copies: A/B/R opened read-only: revision, event count, dirty_causes and dirty_flags counts all unchanged; replay_diff empty; aggregate_valid true
history_integrity.originals_untouched: the real A/B/R .factory/state.db files were never opened by v10 code

tests_updated_not_relaxed: test_observed_gap_paths_are_still_unregistered_in_s1a -> renamed and inverted: the 21 are now registered AND still have no Stage owner
test_policy_presence_matches_ownership_presence -> the relationship is now coverage plus extension, not equality; a policy-only entry must remain invisible to artifact_ownership
test_compatibility_phase_registers_nothing_new -> asserts the exact 18-entry/21-path registration and that nothing shadowed the legacy registry
test_policy_aware_derivation_matches_the_legacy_oracle -> restricted to paths with no native policy; the registered paths are asserted against their intended new behaviour instead
next_stage: G1 (synthetic project gate over the four collection paths), then S5
open_items: the four delivery flags are all false by design; promoting any path is a separate reviewed decision
I8-a / I8-b / true downgrade regression still pending
